mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the housing starts are increasing, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a 3-month period indicates a supply-side contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals a robust consumer demand that outpaces overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period signals deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a slowdown in consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a robust labor market, which is a strong indicator of consumer demand and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the labor market indicators are positive, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
